h1: Custom Pint Magnets for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom pint magnets in bulk for your next promotion. Perfect for businesses, events, and giveaways. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom pint magnets are a versatile promotional item that sticks around — literally. Sized like a pint glass, these magnets offer a generous canvas for your logo or message, making them ideal for restaurants, breweries, or any brand that wants to stand out on metal surfaces. Choose from full-color printing or simple single-color designs to match your brand. Whether you're promoting a grand opening or a seasonal special, pint magnets deliver daily visibility on refrigerators, file cabinets, and more.
heroAltText: Custom pint magnets in assorted colors with a brewery logo, displayed on a refrigerator
